author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a long diagonal blade with four stepped teeth on its lower edge and a diamond grip loop at the lower right; reads as a hand saw. A first attempt with a large rounded-square handle and a dot hole (attempts/v1-square-handle.svg) read as a key or a house and was rejected. The rejected production drawing had a stubby triangular blade with two crude teeth and a heavy ring.
omissions: The reference's double-outlined handle with a separate hole is drawn as one stroked diamond loop (a double outline needs 22+ units across and would dwarf the blade); the blade tip corner is square rather than rounded; four teeth instead of six.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: grip diamond about (34,34) half-diagonal 8; blade back y=x-8 from (34,26) to (14,6), tip edge to (6,14), 5-unit staircase teeth back to the grip's left vertex (26,34).
lucide_reference: No Lucide saw exists; plain 45-degree polygon construction as in Lucide's polygon icons.
